verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents plugin installation, remote triggering via WeChat, Feishu or Telegram, and support for 20+ coding tools. None of it describes a permission, allowlist or admin control that limits which external tools or integrations the agent may access. Community suggestions to wrap ZCode in sandbox-exec or run it under a separate account are user-side workarounds and earn no credit, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can control which external tools and integrations the agent is allowed to access
